text: Nebraska has won 45 straight games against cupcakes. On the road against ranked teams, it's 0-18: its last one came Nov 12, 2011, 17-14 at No. 12 Penn State.
Hot take: Week 4: we like Jaguars +2.5. The books have Bengals by 2.5; our model has it Jaguars by 2.6. Who's taking the other side? (For fun, not betting advice.)
Utah State is 0-9 at Boise State since at least 2005. Saturday: at No. 22 Boise State.
The Eagles are 12-4 against the Rams since 1999. Last meeting: Sep 21, 2025: W 33-26 vs. Los Angeles Rams. They meet again this week.
Weeknight football: 3 games tonight. Headliner: Penn State @ Northwestern, our model likes Northwestern at 52%. Coin flip of the night: Pittsburgh @ Virginia Tech.
Hot take: Iowa (4-0) is #14 in the AP poll. We have them #36. Who's wrong, us or the voters?
Mississippi State has lost 16 straight to Alabama. Last win: Nov 10, 2007, 17-12. Saturday: vs. No. 7 Alabama.
Dalton Schultz (HOU) has 19 catches and still no touchdown. Next: KC Concepcion 17, George Pickens 16.
The Seattle Seahawks (2-1) have the NFL's toughest schedule left: their remaining opponents are a combined 25-17.
Umari Hatcher (SYR) went off: 12 catches, 152 yards, 3 TDs in Syracuse's 42-41 win over UConn.
Jeremiah Smith (OSU) went off: 11 catches, 206 yards, 2 TDs in Ohio State's 31-14 win over Iowa.
Jesse Legree (ORST) went off: 5 catches, 156 yards, 3 TDs in Oregon State's 56-26 win over Colorado State.
Kelby Valsin (FAU) went off: 7 catches, 126 yards, 3 TDs in Florida Atlantic's 66-10 win over Texas Southern.
